q: Find me an opportunity here and draw it on the chart.

q: Where would you enter, and where does the stop go? Draw it.

plan.reason: Downtrend under all MAs; bounce into the 116.55 liquidation magnet is the sell.
plan.invalidation: A 15m close above 117.18 breaks the lower-high structure.

prose: **15-minute SOL leans DOWN — but don't chase here; sell the bounce into 116.55.** - Structure is lower highs and lower lows, price under every moving average (EMA50 116.22, EMA200 117.97). Sellers in control. - Above price sits ~$4.0M of short liquidations at **116.55** — a magnet that can pull a bounce up. That's your gift entry, not a reason to be long. Resistance 117.18 held on its last 3 approaches, so the stop goes just above it at **117.30**. - Caution: volatility is at the top of its own range (stops get run) and 71.9% of the crowd is long — fuel for another flush toward 114.10. Small lesson: entering on a bounce into resistance gives you a tight stop; chasing the breakdown gives you a wide one for the same target. Not financial advice - learn and decide for yourself.

q: Show me where the liquidation pools sit and what they mean for a trade.

plan.reason: $14M of long liquidations below price pulls LINK into 12.72-12.83 before any bounce.
plan.invalidation: A 4h close below 12.045 means the flush kept going, not reversed.

prose: **LINK 4-hour — the fuel is below price, so don't buy here; wait for the flush into 12.72–12.83.** - **Liquidation pools** = clusters of leveraged positions that get force-closed if price reaches them. Below you there's ~$7.8M at **12.829** and ~$6.8M at **12.724** — long liquidations. Above, only ~$1.7–2.0M at 13.70 / 13.88. Heavier side wins: price is magnetised **down** first. - Backing it up: 71.7% of traders are long, funding mildly positive, RSI 31.2 (momentum meter, nearly oversold), structure is lower highs/lower lows. A crowded long book below price is fuel, not support. - The trade: let the pool get eaten, then buy the reaction at **12.724**, stop under the 12.045 swing, targets 13.88 / 14.17. Not financial advice — learn and decide for yourself.
